order_wins: **Lokesh Machines** -- receives an order of Rs 19.89 cr (net of taxes) from Cummins India for a special-finish milling and boring machine _(~2.5% of mcap)_.
**Accord Transformer & Switchgear** -- three purchase orders totalling Rs 4.85 cr ex-GST, led by Rs 4.55 cr from Inergy Infra _(~3.0% of mcap)_.
**Skytech Infinite Platform** -- Rs 1.30 cr purchase order (ex-GST) from an OEM contractor for FLP electrical panels and wiring _(~4.3% of mcap)_.
**Arabian Petroleum** -- purchase order of about Rs 9.5 cr from MOIL for lubricant supply at Nagpur and Balaghat _(~8.1% of mcap)_.
**ABS Marine Services** -- charters offshore support vessel MV Serenity to G R Infraprojects for ONGC-field work, about Rs 21.94 cr incl. GST over 160 days _(~3.1% of mcap (our arithmetic))_.

**Apana Logistics** -- four-year contract worth about Rs 9.36 cr from a domestic logistics company for container transport at a CFS with 10 multi-axle vehicles, from 4-Dec-2026 _(~25.3% of mcap (our arithmetic))_.
fund_raises_fresh_equity: **Evonile Pharma** -- Letter of Offer fixes the rights issue at Rs 884.75 cr (1,02,87,832 shares at Rs 860, 5 for 12, record date 11-Nov), against the Rs 900 cr approved on 8-Oct.

**Flywings Simulator Training Centre** -- Board approves up to 29,87,760 warrants at Rs 245 for Rs 73.20 cr to promoter and public allottees, subject to shareholder approval; the 30-Oct figure was Rs 68.20 cr.
**Indel Money** -- Board approves raising up to Rs 500 cr through unlisted compulsorily convertible preference shares (a proposal; investor and terms not stated).
**Arvaya Healthcare** -- revises its 4-Nov outcome: the Rights Issue Committee is authorised to adopt the draft letter of offer for a partly paid-up rights issue of up to Rs 210 cr (approved 11-Jul).
equity_allotments: **Aequs** -- allots 2,80,71,690 fresh warrants at Rs 231.55 each, Rs 649.99 cr per the filing, to a single allottee; at least 50% paid at subscription, balance due by 31-Dec-2027 (new warrants).

**Aeroflex Neu** -- allots 48,00,000 shares at Rs 90 (Rs 80 premium), Rs 43.20 cr (our arithmetic), on converting warrants issued in 2025; parent Aeroflex Enterprises takes 36,00,000, lifting its stake to 58.56% (conversion of past warrants).
**Godavari Drugs** -- allots 7,86,690 equity shares to the promoter category at Rs 89 on warrant conversion, after receiving the balance Rs 5.25 cr (conversion of past warrants).
**Sun Retail** -- allots 15,16,14,786 fully convertible warrants at Rs 1 each, Rs 15.16 cr, to five allottees as the second tranche of its preferential issue (new warrants).

**Sellwin Traders** -- allots 77,05,000 equity shares on converting warrants issued preferentially; price not stated in the pages read, paid-up capital rises to Rs 50.54 cr (conversion of past warrants).
**Desi Farms India** -- receives exchange listing approval for 3,18,24,590 equity shares allotted on a preferential basis (from the filing's subject; its text is not in the cache).
m_and_a: **Welspun Enterprises** -- completes its exit from NXT Infra MCP Highways: receives the final-tranche consideration of about Rs 339.38 cr and transfers the stake to NXT-Infra Trust _(~3.9% of mcap)_.
**John Cockerill India** -- allots non-cash CCPS worth Rs 204.17 cr to John Cockerill SA as the swap consideration for acquiring 79.44% of John Cockerill Metals International SA, Belgium.
**Aditya Infotech** -- Board approves investing Rs 45.4 cr for a 30% stake in KGraph AI Solutions (BLUE), an AI video-compression company, at a post-money value of about Rs 151 cr.
**Euro Pratik Sales** -- to acquire 51% of Drashti Surfaces for an investment of up to Rs 31.12 cr _(~1.8% of mcap)_.
**Ashok Leyland** -- NCLT Mumbai sanctions the absorption of Hinduja Leyland Finance into NDL Ventures; NDL becomes the material listed subsidiary once the scheme takes effect.

**Samvardhana Motherson International** -- Board approves a new Paraguay manufacturing facility through buying 100% of Golden Bridge SA, a shell with nil turnover; consideration not in the pages read.
**Kaycee Industries** -- Board approves acquiring 100% of Kaycee Electricals India Limited as a wholly owned subsidiary; consideration is not stated in the pages read.
**Mufin Green Finance** -- Board approves an MoU with Arthum's platform to lend to its workers and contractors, plus proposed stakes of 20% in Arthum and 23% in Bimapay Finsure, terms to be agreed.
**EPACK Durable** -- terminates by mutual agreement its July-2025 joint venture agreement with Bumjin Electronics of Korea.
capex_core: **Happy Forgings** -- Board approves capex of Rs 500 cr to expand its existing forging and machining capacity.
**Safari Industries** -- Board approves capex of up to Rs 170 cr for the company and up to Rs 60 cr for subsidiary Safari Manufacturing, lifting that unit's capacity to 16 lakh pieces a month.
**Knowledge Marine & Engineering Works** -- completes buying the dredger River Pearl 48 at a capital cost of about Rs 250 cr, for deployment at New Mangalore Port from 15-Nov.
**Jain Resource Recycling** -- subsidiary Jain Green Technologies starts a copper cathode line at Gummidipoondi with initial capacity of 750 MT a month.
business_updates: **Results season** — 769 companies filed results / earnings-call material today (press releases, recordings, transcripts, presentations) — tracked in the Results tab, not itemised here.

**VA Tech Wabag** -- H1 FY27 consolidated revenue Rs 1,887 cr (Rs 18,870 mn), up 20%, PAT Rs 194.7 cr (Rs 1,947 mn), up 29%; order book above Rs 20,000 cr and net cash above Rs 1,000 cr, per its press release.
**M&B Engineering** -- Q2 FY27 revenue Rs 385 cr, up 25.4%, and PAT Rs 29 cr, up 32.8%; orders on hand Rs 1,109 cr, up 19.2% YoY.
**Rashi Peripherals** -- Q2 FY27 revenue Rs 6,185 cr (Rs 61,851 mn) and its highest-ever PAT of Rs 130.7 cr, up 120% YoY; H1 PAT Rs 235.3 cr.
**Uno Minda** -- Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue Rs 6,655 cr, up 38%, EBITDA Rs 733 cr, up 33%, and PAT Rs 420 cr, up 38%.
**Paras Healthcare** -- first results since its 28-Oct listing: Q2 FY27 revenue Rs 510.9 cr, up 22.8%, EBITDA up 42.5% to Rs 126.6 cr, PAT Rs 40.4 cr, 3.3x.
**Amagi Media Labs** -- Q2 FY27 revenue Rs 476 cr, up 27%, adjusted EBITDA up 114% to Rs 89 cr, PAT Rs 75 cr versus about one-thirtieth of that a year earlier.
**Britannia Industries** -- Q2 FY27 consolidated sales Rs 5,542 cr, up 16.6% on 13% volume growth; net profit Rs 726 cr, up 10.8%.
**Campus Activewear** -- Q2 FY27 volumes 63.4 lakh pairs, up 10.2%, revenue Rs 452 cr, up 16.9%, and PAT Rs 24 cr, up 21.3%.
**Sula Vineyards** -- Q2 FY27 net revenue Rs 135.5 cr, up 3.5%, EBITDA Rs 27.5 cr, up 8.1%, net profit Rs 8.1 cr, up 34.4%; wine tourism revenue Rs 16.3 cr, up 23.7%.
**UGRO Capital** -- Q2 FY27 disbursements Rs 3,159 cr, up 77% YoY, above Rs 1,000 cr in each month; PAT Rs 50.7 cr, up 17%; AUM Rs 15,019 cr, up 23%.
**Excelsoft Technologies** -- Q2 FY27 revenue up 25% and H1 revenue up 34%, per its press release title.
**Safari Industries** -- Q2 FY27 revenue Rs 582.22 cr, up 9.1%, PAT Rs 36.93 cr; interim dividend Rs 2 a share.
**Kalyani Forge** -- H1 FY27 PBT up 118.8% and EBITDA up 38.8%; Board approves a Rs 45 cr FY27 funding plan mixing equity, debt and non-core asset sales.
**Moneyboxx Finance** -- monthly disbursements rise from Rs 24.5 cr in August to Rs 32.4 cr in September and over Rs 50 cr in October (provisional).
**Mahamaya Steel Industries** -- October 2026 sales of 17,817.95 MT.
**Mahamaya Steel Industries** -- the same October sales figure of 17,817.95 MT, as filed on BSE.

**Signature Global (India)** -- Q2 FY27 revenue Rs 820 cr, up 148%, PAT Rs 70 cr against a Rs 50 cr loss; pre-sales Rs 1,830 cr versus Rs 2,020 cr, H1 pre-sales Rs 3,800 cr versus Rs 4,660 cr (Rs bn figures converted from the filing).
**NLC India** -- subsidiary NLC India Renewables signs the power purchase agreement with SJVN for 100 MW of the 200 MW wind project it won on 4-Sep, supply to begin by 3-Nov-2028.
**GAIL (India)** -- subsidiary GMPL commissions the revived 1.25 MTPA PTA plant at Mangalore SEZ, bought through insolvency in 2023.
distress_risk: **Shilpa Medicare** -- NCLAT sets aside the 9-Sep NCLT order that put wholly owned FTF Pharma into insolvency; the process stands annulled.
other_notable: **Manaksia Coated Metals** -- signs an export MoU worth Rs 210 cr with a European client (an MoU, not a booked order); exports were Rs 397 cr in H1 FY27.
**Arihant Capital Markets** -- SEBI grants in-principle approval for it to sponsor and set up a mutual fund.
